name: lumenary
description: Twenty ways to see an image. A browser-only studio with twenty Canvas 2D treatments (ASCII, halftone, neon, glitch and more), plus a theory page with the maths behind each. Nothing is uploaded.

paragraphs: Twenty ways to see an image. A browser-only studio: pick one of twenty treatments, drop in a photo, adjust a few controls, save the result.
Nothing is uploaded. All processing happens on the visitor's device with the Canvas 2D API, so there is no server, no API key and no database.

Touch devices have no hover, so the cursor-following preview makes no sense there. @include hover-only and @include touch-only swap the desktop hover preview for inline thumbnails on phones, and useMediaQuery in FloatingPreview makes sure JavaScript does the same.
features: Stack: Vite, React 18, React Router 6, SCSS, plus three small libraries for the interface: motion (springs and scroll-linked animation), lenis (smooth scrolling) and katex (typeset equations). The image engine itself…
Routes: / is the homepage. /theory explains the maths behind every treatment. /style/ is one page per treatment (twenty in total).
Palette: black is primary, white is secondary, with greys in between.
Treatments: 9 are live (animated, respond to the cursor, can record a 6 second WebM clip) and 11 are stills (export a PNG at 1x to 3x).
